==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis.

This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster.)

Celestial Dragon Jet entered Leon through the Dimension Door. (Celestial Dragon Jet first appeared in a dream on 09/13/2025. They are a heroic variant of me, Jet, from another Storyverse world. They were originally a corrupted variant of me, Dark Dragon Mask Jet, until I traveled back in time and replaced their Dark Dragon Tome with a Celestial Dragon Tome.) (The Dimension Door inside of Leon first appeared in a dream on 09/14/2025. It leads to many different worlds, and it can be opened on both sides.)

But he was followed by a faceless purple Jet with acidic tendrils who nearly killed him. (I call this villainous variant of myself, Acid Jet. Their acid seems to be very Lucid Light resistant.)

I repelled Acid Jet out the door, as he made it clear that his goal is to shape the Storyverse in his image. (Acid Jet claimed to be the one who planted the Dark Dragon Tome in the first place.)
